notes: enabled: uploads happen only when true (on since the secrets were set; Google no longer locks API uploads of unaudited projects as private, so no audit is needed: production/YOUTUBE.md, step 7). follow_release_schedule: premiere each episode at its slot in production/schedule.json (the same moment the wiki and the GitHub release go public); `schedule` is only the fallback for a slot that has already passed. category 20 = Gaming. weekdays: 0 = Monday. max_per_run: uploads per run (the nightly run, and the run after each new story release); the queue goes in order of publish time across the story and every series. playlist_id: the story's episodes (shorts_playlist_id: its Shorts, if set). series: other shows whose uploads (times, titles, descriptions, tags) come from a plan file in their GitHub release; every upload goes to the series' playlist. An upload without a time in the plan waits until `times` gives it one, e.g. {"e11-trailer": "2026-11-24 18:00"} (local time); `times` also overrides a plan time. retext: find/replace rules applied to every description, at upload and (each run, after its command) to the videos already on YouTube; a rule that no longer matches costs nothing. Added 25 Oct 2026: Act 1 of the story ended with Episode 10 (no more weekday episodes for now) and the Pit's T-Rex bonus got a date (Wed 25 Nov, from the pit-s1 plan) instead of the 100-subscriber unlock.
